notes.title: Thank you for playing Growbot!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29395506/2ce66a2895debef2be4c6e924a0be6c9da93b462.png[/img]

Growbot has been out for almost 3 weeks! :D Thank you to everyone who has played the game so far, we hope you have enjoyed it :)

If you liked playing Growbot please consider leaving us a review, it would mean a great deal, and help us reach more people who might enjoy it too. Thank you! <3

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29395506/e269624c0c68953f58b13def42125b889be48225.png[/img]

[h2]Patch 1.0.3 released[/h2]
We've just released version 1.0.3. with a few minor bug fixes.
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with missing inventory items near the end of the game
[*] Fixed a bug in the Engine room that would lock pieces in the wrong place 
[*] Improved font characters for some languages
[*] Localization fixes
[/list]

[h2]Great reviews are in[/h2]
Growbot has received some really lovely reviews so far! Please check them out below :) 

[list]
[*][i]"Growbot is an incredible game that deserves to be experienced by everyone, regardless of age or gender. It’s such a unique and heart-warming experience, one that must be lived rather than described with words. Let this masterpiece transport you in a “children’s book”-like world, full of emotion, color and make you forget about the daily problems for a few hours."[/i]
[b]100/100[/b] - [url=https://lillycorner.com/2021/10/27/growbot/]lillycorner.com[/url]

[*][i]"Growbot is, directly, an interactive work of art that we are going to thank very much for having played. Although he did not invent the wheel at any time, the union of all its elements form an incredible game, very careful and that transmits sensations in every minute of play. From here we can only recommend its purchase without fear, as it is one of those works that remain in the memory over the years."[/i]
[b]90/100[/b] - [url=https://www.hgunified.com/gaming/review-growbot-pc.html]hgunified.com[/url]

[*][i]"Growbot is a game which is soothing for the soul. It doesn't make you feel upset, it doesn't stress you out, it just lets you loose in its dream world, and by the time you wake up, the credits are already rolling."[/i]
[b]89/100[/b] - [url=https://www.pcguru.hu/teszt/growbot-teszt-pc/3825]pcguru.hu, Hungary[/url]

[*][i]"Growbot one of the most curious, carefully crafted and full of emotion experiences that I have been able to experience in the last few months. And I urge anyone who wants to enjoy something precious, particular and emotional, not to pass it by and come to this curious and magical world of robots, plants, and very special beings."[/i]
[b]85/100[/b] - [url=https://www.generacionpixel.com/2021/10/22/analisis-growbot/]generacionpixel.com, Spain[/url]

[*][i]"If you like art, a feel-good narrative with a decent selection of puzzles, this cute point and click is an interstellar trip you should take."[/i]
[b]82/100[/b] - [url=https://vulgarknight.com/review/growbot-review/]vulgarknight.com, UK[/url]

[*][i]"In Growbot we experience a hand-drawn adventure with a story that is easy to digest and great visual and auditory elements that are bursting with indie charm. The gameplay is mainly based on solving various puzzles. Overall, the title's playing time could definitely be longer, but fans of puzzle gameplay will nonetheless have a good time with Growbot."[/i]
[b]82/100[/b] - [url=https://gamecontrast.de/growbot-review/]gamecontrast.de, Germany[/url]

[*][i]"Growbot is a candy that you savour with pleasure. You can feel the love behind every scene, every character and every musical note, the same love that is inevitably transferred to the player. Wabisabi Play's work feels like a fish in water among its drawings and colours, which fill the screen with an incomparable sense of peace. I wish I could move in with the Nara and the Growbots."[/i]
[b]80/100[/b] - [url=https://uvejuegos.com/analisis/Growbot/Cultivando-nuestro-futuro/9042/65252]uvejuegos.com, Spain[/url]

[*][i]"Growbot is slow but never boring, beautiful but never shallow and rich in sound but never obtrusively scored. Lisa Evans has managed to turn her vision into a point-and-click that doesn't need to hide from its inspirations."[/i]
[b]80/100[/b] - [url=https://indieplanet.de/tests/growbot/]indieplanet.de, Germany[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: Growbot is OUT!
notes.content:
[h2]Growbot has launched! :D[/h2] 

Hi all! We're very excited to finally share our wistful adventure, Growbot with you! <3

We hope you enjoy the game, and we are super grateful for your feedback and comments. Thank you for your support and patience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29395506/e269624c0c68953f58b13def42125b889be48225.png[/img]

If you’re new to Growbot, here’s a small overview: 
[list]
[*]A point and click puzzle adventure game. 
[*]Drawn by hand, inspired by the puzzlers of old. 
[*]Beautiful original soundtrack by Jessica Fichot. 
[*]Full of fantastical creatures and strange environments to explore.[/list] 

In Growbot, you will play as Nara on her first day as a Growbot in training to become a Captain. Things go awry across the station and you will need to use your wits, and brain(apilla) to solve the puzzles and repair the station.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29395506/0fb294a216cd6f9a9eba3a8ddf9be5c0ff9b1776.png[/img]

Over the years a lot of people have poured their time and care into making Growbot, and we are grateful to everyone who has helped. With special thanks to our publisher Application Systems Heidelberg for publishing the game, and working with us on development; to Acorn Games for helping with social media; and to Jessica Fichot, for the wonderful music she created for the game. 

Thanks very much for following our journey, and for playing Growbot! If you have not played the game yet, please give it a try! :) We've had some great press reviews in already (please see below).

If you enjoyed Growbot please leave a Steam review, we really appreciate it, and it will help others find Growbot too! 


Thank you! <3 
Growbot team
____

[list]
[*][i]"Growbot is a game which is soothing for the soul. It doesn't make you feel upset, it doesn't stress you out, it just lets you loose in its dream world, and by the time you wake up, the credits are already rolling."[/i]
[b]89/100[/b] - [url=https://www.pcguru.hu/teszt/growbot-teszt-pc/3825]pcguru.hu, Hungary[/url]

[*][i]"Growbot one of the most curious, carefully crafted and full of emotion experiences that I have been able to experience in the last few months. And I urge anyone who wants to enjoy something precious, particular and emotional, not to pass it by and come to this curious and magical world of robots, plants, and very special beings."[/i]
[b]85/100[/b] - [url=https://www.generacionpixel.com/2021/10/22/analisis-growbot/]generacionpixel.com, Spain[/url]

[*][i]"If you like art, a feel-good narrative with a decent selection of puzzles, this cute point and click is an interstellar trip you should take."[/i]
[b]82/100[/b] - [url=https://vulgarknight.com/review/growbot-review/]vulgarknight.com, UK[/url]

[*][i]"Growbot is a candy that you savour with pleasure. You can feel the love behind every scene, every character and every musical note, the same love that is inevitably transferred to the player. Wabisabi Play's work feels like a fish in water among its drawings and colours, which fill the screen with an incomparable sense of peace. I wish I could move in with the Nara and the Growbots."[/i]
[b]80/100[/b] - [url=https://uvejuegos.com/analisis/Growbot/Cultivando-nuestro-futuro/9042/65252]uvejuegos.com, Spain[/url]

[*][i]"The world of illustrator Lisa Evans is brought to life in this colourful and detailed adventure game. Its gameplay relies on narrative and puzzles rather than taking the conventional adventure game route, and while it doesn't do anything that hasn't been seen before, it does what it does very well."[/i]
[b]80/100[/b] - [url=https://portal.33bits.net/analisis-growbot/]33bits.net, Spain[/url]
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29395506/9daebbd584705775f51bf2d93f5db0a8aa5e525d.png[/img]

[list]
[*][i]"To conclude, Growbot may be a short and simple game. But the idea of the shield creator is quite unique. It breaks the routine of the simple Point & Click as you can see everywhere. Moreover, the story is quite cute, and you feel a lot of love in this game. "[/i]
[b]8/10[/b] - [url=https://www.coupleofgamer.com/post/test-steam-growbot]coupleofgamer.com, France[/url]

[*][i]"All in all, 'Growbot' is a very nice game, a bit in the style of 'Machinarium' (which was one of the inspirations of the creators). Maybe a bit too short, maybe the ending is a bit disappointing, but it has a lot of interesting puzzles and is very well made. I recommend it to every fan of the genre."[/i]
[b]8/10[/b] - [url=https://forum.przygodomania.pl/viewtopic.php?f=1340&t=7963]przygodomania.pl, Poland[/url]

[*][i]"Growbot is an old-fashioned point-and-click puzzle game that will keep fans of the genre glued to the screen and certainly bring new ones to this timeless genre, thanks to the in-game help that will prevent it from becoming frustrating.

The variety of the puzzles proposed, mixed with the musical ones, in addition to the characters and a fairy tale story, will succeed in immersing the player in this timeless adventure.

Definitely a title recommended for fans of the genre and in general for anyone who wants to enjoy a good adventure and squeeze their brains a bit."[/i]
[b]75/100[/b] - [url=https://www.icrewplay.com/growbot-un-titolo-vecchio-stile-da-favola/]icrewplay.com, Italy[/url]
[/list]

notes.title: September Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/fbc8784704af9a11963f592ed935072468fc90d6.jpg[/img]

Floor 3 is nearly done! We received some great feedback on our underwater demo at Gamescom and we’re excited to finish the floor and hear what Jessica comes up with for the music. Here’s a piece she created for when you find the Captain: https://soundcloud.com/user-548253191/finding-the-captain-by-jessica-fichot

By the end of floor 3 Nara has grown confident in her ability to defend and repair the station. But she has become less sure of her beliefs about the world and characters around her. 

Nara uses a public memory device to watch the origin story of Quasi crystal, after which she is left feeling uncomfortable and full of new questions. Nara has a lot of digging to do if she is to unearth the whole truth.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/20ba837e0407a36d05113bf776a476b816c93915.gif[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/a805d56801a4b2380b3eaf93847f6e2a62dbd77e.gif[/img]

We are about half way through creating the origins of Quasi crystal cutscene and have been exploring a new method of delivering the story in several panels, instead of a single clip. We want the player to have control over how they move through and digest the information.

The task this month is to tie all the rooms, puzzles, cutscenes and converations together and make sure everything flows and feels like an organic experience. 

We have one last room on this floor to complete, wherein Nara converses with the astral projection of the head gardener to learn their memories of Quasi crystal. The head gardener created Quasi crystal.  

Floor 3/Room 1: Free the water dragons from the maze and interact with starbelly and the public memory crystals.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/a9a6785b421572948a52586bccefa5c7db442dd6.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/2867e6fd7a2f6521bab9ebb21d45fe4c4ac5bf5b.jpg[/img]

Floor 3/Room 2: Help the light sprites get home and retrieve a couple of colour brites.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/f1e703e00d1a48b41f29ae470e5eb1ebff124708.jpg[/img]

Floor 3/Room 3: Restore colour to a coral reef and return a frog to a squid.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/751bdab237e95b5c94feb4f491477c3499662229.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/ebc27bc476bc3230021a36343a3e04e49715d495.jpg[/img]

Returning to the captain after collecting melodies from the melobees and waterdragons.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/42c410c46af52e77580ece1c1b2467eb2f154451.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/0fa6b71eeae0ee1c5bb1c74f4b23ab09812dab9f.jpg[/img]

Watching people play the demo at gamescom was super useful, and highlighted game design choices we need to improve on. We’ll be making changes based on what we saw, so thank you for playing the game, and for helping it develop and improve :) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29395506/bf206ef2df09d574ae5b8e75cc6b271917538581.gif[/img]

notes.title: November Update: Busy as a Melobee
notes.content:
Hello, and happy autumn! :) Since EGX we've been hard at work on floor 3.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/A9NiZAB.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9WUcPwu.gif[/img]

When you enter the underwater floor you are now met by an anxious water dragon who requests your help to free his friends, whom are trapped within a broken down maze. 

Still trying to work out what a water dragons voice would sound like!? 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/xZxnSHa.gif[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/eI5clJ6.gif[/img]

In room 2 we’ve been primarily focused on fixing bugs within the water pipe system, and also hiding colour brites in shells... Next steps are to animate the brites, and our current thinking is that their swimming should be propelled by their moustaches :)

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tVsU1Fg.gif[/img]

Room 3 is probably the most complex on the floor. There are a number of puzzles and dialogue systems which all need to work in tandem. We’ve been building the wheel puzzle and conversation system with the coral reef.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8npnGFt.gif[/img]

All of the animation clips and code for the bottom set of wheels have been completed. When you use a switch which is locked, the switch moves slightly to let you know its state. When the correct wheels are placed on the cogs, they lock into place, and when you try to remove them, a small animation clip lets you know they are locked. All of these minor animation clips can feel like unimportant details, not worthy of dev time, but they create a responsive world which strengthens a player's sense of immersion.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CPQOfPk.gif[/img]

Animating the coral reef's face as they talk is going well, but it has proven challenging. We focused on the eyes and mouth, but noticed the overall result lacked emotion. Our next step is to animate the face rising and falling as the reef talks, to see if this helps.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tQn1tgW.gif[/img]

Writing and implementing the coral reef's dialogue content has been fun. I'm looking forward to creating Mavis, the latent psychic squid! :)

There are a number of cutscenes on this floor which contain important information about the story. By the end of this floor, the player will have learnt about the origins and motivations of Quasi Crystal, the perpetrator of the ongoing attacks, and have a broader but darker perspective on the Growbot world.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/B8jCGXH.gif[/img]

I think that’s it for now. Thank you for following our dev journey! :) <3
